exposure: Advanced maternal age mothers (over 35 years old)
outcome: Colostrum levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-6, IL-8, TNF-α)
cohort: 214 mothers (117 adolescents, 39 advanced maternal age, 58 control)
finding: Colostrum of mothers with advanced age had higher levels of IL-1β and IL-6 compared to adolescent mothers, but not the control group, indicating maternal age influences colostrum cytokine composition.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age mothers were more likely to deliver by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was measured but no significant difference was found between groups
